publication_notes: The initial Windows-to-WSL quoted commit command truncated the unpublished title and did not push.
The title was corrected before first publication.
A WSL read-only remote check stalled; its headless retry returned 128 and gh was absent in WSL.
Stopped the stalled read-only check and used already-authenticated native Windows Git/gh.
Native push and remote-head equality succeeded; no credentials were exported.
